name: Global Plant Genetics (GPG)
description: Commercial IP/licensing platform spanning blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and strawberry genetics. Extended its raspberry representation contract with James Hutton Ltd, giving it exclusive representation for James Hutton's raspberry genetics for Moroccan and Tunisian producers (Hortidaily).

attributes.role_note: Licensing/representation platform, not itself a breeding program -- represents James Hutton Ltd's raspberry genetics commercially for Morocco and Tunisia.
